h1.title: Your IP and a rough location
hero.subtitle: This card is the address your connection is using right now. City and network names come from registration data, usually only as far as a city, not the spot you are standing.
trust.text: Privacy: results come from third-party IP geolocation services (the IP/domain you query is sent to them); apart from this we do not store your input on our servers.
seo.title: Your IP and a rough location
seo.description: See your public IP, the registered location, ASN and time zone. You can also look up another IPv4 or IPv6 address. The place is a city-level estimate, not where you are standing.
feedback.copyFailed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
